messages:
Maya (Product): quick thread 1 need input on soft-cap + paid-burst policy for the microbundle pilot. Draft: soft cap at 75k tokens/day, 40 QPS per endpoint, 3x burst for 8h. Goal: low friction onboarding, predictable ops.
Sam (Sales): customers want self-serve burst requests. Field reps hate writing legal exceptions. can we do automated short-term increases tied to prepay or billing status?
Priya (Customer Success): strongly +1 to self-serve. CS wants 2-tier UX: immediate soft burst (up to 2x for 8h) and request-for-more (triage by ops). Alerts in-app and email.
Jun (Eng): infra notes: soft caps are rate-limited, not hard throttles. Implementation path: token counter per org + per-endpoint QPS windows, plus a burst token bucket. Rough ETA: 2 engineers, 3 weeks. Need metrics: "throttle_events", "burst_granted", "burst_denied", "avg_latency_post_burst".
Ravi (Finance): billing implications: if we allow instant bursts without prepay we risk unexpected costs. recommend auto-charge for paid bursts or require billing-enabled orgs. Also need proration rules.
Lena (Legal): require contract-safe wording. No implied availability guarantee for bursts. Add revocation clause; for customer-requested temporary increases require signed addendum for >30 days.
Maya (Product): proposed rules:
- Soft cap: 75k/day, non-blocking alerts at 80%
- Auto-soft-burst: up to 2x for 8h for billing-enabled accounts, single-use per 30d
- Paid-burst: up to 5x for 30d if prepay or signed addendum
- Hard cap: 5x absolute maximum per account, engineering gated
Jun (Eng): config sample:
```
cap_config: {
  soft_daily_tokens: 75000,
  soft_alert_threshold: 0.8,
  auto_burst_multiplier: 2,
  auto_burst_window_hours: 8,
  paid_burst_multiplier: 5,
  paid_burst_min_prepay: 1000.00
}
```
Jun (Eng): also propose a safety circuit: if avg_latency increases >30% during burst, auto-revoke burst and notify ops.
Priya (Customer Success): request flow UX: "Request burst" button -> quick form (reason, desired multiplier, duration) -> CS + Ops notification -> auto-approve for auto-burst rules. Need copy for in-product banners and escalation templates.
Sam (Sales): can Sales request temporary exceptions in the console on behalf of a signed customer? would speed deals.
Lena (Legal): Sales can initiate but legal must attach the standard addendum for >7d. For <7d auto-bursts, include standard T&Cs in the Billing UI.
Maya (Product): launch gating for GA: telemetry deployed, billing integration complete, UI flows wired, legal T&Cs visible, <0.5% of orgs hit hard cap in canary, runbook and playbook done.
ops-bot: Canary window opened tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Monitoring dashboards: microbundle/burst, microbundle/latency, billing/burst_charges.
Jun (Eng): estimate update: add 1 sprint for telemetry/dashboard, 1 sprint for enforcement + UI endpoints, plus 0.5 sprint for billing hooks.
Ravi (Finance): need surge pricing table for paid bursts and confirmation on currency + rounding. I'll attach a stub to the PRD.
Maya (Product): decision: proceed with soft-cap + auto-burst for GA, paid-burst pilot opt-in. Legal & Finance to finalize wording/pricing by EOD Thursday. Eng to scope sprint.
Sam (Sales): will flag top pilot accounts and prep outreach.
Priya (Customer Success): will draft banner copy and email templates; will run SR for UX prototype.
Lena (Legal): will publish T&Cs and addendum drafts to the doc by EOD Thursday.
Maya (Product): thanks team. I'll update the roadmap ticket with GA criteria and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
